column1: # The numbers a source is read with: shares and limits measured on a source, each named by its source. Ours; each row says
#   why. Edit a row and run forge build: every product made with one names this file among its inputs. A parameter no reader
# Columns: source, parameter, value (a number; a share is a fraction of 1), reason.
#   berean placed-rows, placed-both  the shares of a verse's table rows (and of the witness's words) placed on the witness's
#                                    words below which the verse is refused (stated-pairs, BSB-NESTLE1904)

column4: a verse whose table rows are placed on the witness's words fewer than this share of them is refused: the two are not the same verse (Matthew 21:29 reads another clause)

a verse whose rows are placed fewer than this share of both its rows and the witness's words is refused: where one side runs on into the next verse or stops short, the other side's words are nearly all placed
